item.description: In celebration of the Holy Month of Ramadan, His Highness Sheikh Dr. Sultan bin Mohammed Al Qasimi, Supreme Council Member and Ruler of Sharjah, has ordered the release of 738 inmates from the emirate’s correctional and punitive facility. item.title: Pakistan confirms start of Ramadan after crescent moon sighting
item.description: Pakistan has officially announced the beginning of Ramadan after the Central Ruet-e-Hilal Committee confirmed that the crescent moon was sighted. Committee chairman Maulana Abdul Khabir Azad declared that Thursday marks the first day of Ramadan 1447 Hijri in the country.
